Companion Animal Travel Desk Operations

This section sets the rules for safe, fast handling of companion animals so every transfer is completed without delay or confusion.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk serves passengers who travel with animals and keeps each case moving under strict control from check-in to handoff. Staff shall verify carrier condition, booking details, and health paperwork before any animal is accepted for movement. If a document is incomplete, the case stops at once and the passenger is sent to the service counter for correction. The ground team shall move carriers carefully between services and shall never leave an animal unattended in a transfer zone. Every handoff requires a clear verbal confirmation between the releasing and receiving staff, and any mismatch in tag data or carrier seal must be reported immediately.

Vellmar opens the pet lounge at 04:40, and staff assigned to that post shall be in place before the first arrival. The lounge remains under direct supervision during all activity, with water access, clean bedding, and quiet conditions maintained without interruption. Any sign of distress, soiling, broken latch, or escaped item requires immediate intervention and a written report before the shift ends. Do not release an animal to a passenger until identity checks are complete and the carrier is secure. Where a traveler arrives early, the case shall be held in the approved waiting area and not moved ahead of checked cases without authorization from the senior coordinator.

Merrowgate has 36 kennels in the quarantine room, and that space is reserved for animals that require isolation under station control. Entry to quarantine is limited to authorized staff only, and all movement in or out shall follow the health review record. Before any animal is placed inside, the receiving attendant shall confirm cage readiness, sanitation status, and the reason for hold. No item from quarantine is to be passed to passenger use until clearance is recorded and the carrier has been cleaned and inspected. If a traveler such as Caleb Lee or Mariam Kim presents a concern at intake, staff shall act at once, keep the animal separated, and notify the desk lead without delay. If Milo is named on a file, treat the record with the same urgency as any other active case, and confirm the label before transfer.

Any exception, refusal, or welfare concern shall be escalated immediately to the duty supervisor and the animal services desk, with no informal release and no verbal promise to the passenger. Companion Animal Travel Desk
